turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You are not to think of such things, my wife. I will care for our son and make sure he is fed and clothed, you are not to worry about that.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have lived my life as a good wife and mother, and now I want to see my son happy and settled before I go.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please don't talk about going, you're not going anywhere. I'll take care of the farm and make sure Father is happy, just like you want.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not see the spring again, nor the summer, but I want to see you wedded and settled, my son, before I go.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: But, mother, what if I were to marry soon? Would that make you happy before you go?

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You will not think of dying, my wife. You will get well, and we will see our son married and settled in the spring.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have no more strength to think of the farm or the spring, but I want you to promise me, son, that you will marry this good maid before I go.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I promise you, Mother, I'll marry the maid and make you proud before you're gone. I'll make sure everything is taken care of, just like Father said.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Why do you talk of dying, O-lan? You will get well, and we will see our son married and settled in the spring, just as you wish.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Thank you, sir, for your promise. I will take care of everything and help your mother with the household until you are married.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am glad you promise to marry the maid, son. It will be a great comfort to me to see you settled before I go.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have done all I can, and now I want to see you happy, my son. Do not forget to plant new crops for the spring, it is a hard time, but with new crops, we will have food to eat.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will try to help, Mother, but I am not sure if I can take care of everything by myself.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You must plant the crops, son, and I will not trouble you with the household. The maid will help me, and I will rest.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry about me, I will take care of everything, just rest and know that I will be happy with the maid

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am glad you promise to marry the maid, son, and I will be at peace knowing she will take care of you.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I don't want to cause you any trouble, Mother, but I fear I may not be able to manage everything on my own.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will rest easier, knowing that you are settled with the maid, and that the crops will be planted.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not have you speak of dying and trouble O-lan, she is still with us and the crops need to be planted.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I must see you wedded to the maid, son, before I close my eyes, so that I may know you are settled and I can be at peace.
